payload.meaning: Pass an empty object. The stop reapplies saved display policy; it accepts no setting values.

changed.meaning: The stop reports whether an effect or stored change was observed on this path.

receiptPath.meaning: Path to the native settings run.json written on a successful receipt path.

receipt.meaning: Native settings receipt metadata: ok, changed, kind, fields, backups and commands; entries describe files and command outcomes.

backups.meaning: Original file metadata for files backed up by the act.

commands.meaning: Arguments and return codes for the dispatched tools.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Whether the stop reports acting; this is not an assertion that every effect completed.

values.meaning: Display policy fallback values on a structured Sway failure.

settingsSource.meaning: Source of those display policy values, when included.

backend.meaning: Selected compositor coordinates on a structured refusal.

requested.meaning: Recognized display fields reported on a refused nonempty apply payload.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when an unexpected fault is reported by the front door instead of the stop.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Absent when the stop emits no signal. The enum lists literal outcomes. A missing Sway backend is reported as no-fields-supplied. Command setup faults can report command-unavailable:<exception class>. Failed compensation can prefix the original diagnostic with rollback-failed:, live-rollback-failed: or position-rollback-failed:, including the rollback diagnostic. Filesystem and malformed compositor reply errors can pass through as exception text. The envelope reader also reports the missing kernel keys by name.
